articles.title: Kraken focused on building foundation for success during lengthy road trip
Melanson diagnosed with vascular aneurysm, out indefinitely for Kraken

out.detail: indefinitely with anterior mediastinum hematoma with vascular pseudo aneurysm (upper body)

away.summary: The Seattle Kraken (4-2-0) are on a five-game road trip, having won their first two games against Detroit and Washington. They lead the NHL in blocked shots per game (17.83) and are tied for 2nd in takeaways. Offensively, they have nine players with five or more points, led by Jared McCann (2g, 5a). Defensively, they will be without Jacob Melanson (indefinite) and Ryan Lindgren (upper body), but otherwise have a relatively healthy roster entering the game.

out.detail: lower body injury (missed past two games)
upper body injury (missed both weekend games)
upper body injury (missed last four games)

home.summary: The Philadelphia Flyers (0-5-2) are seeking their first win of the season and are playing their fourth game in six nights. They have struggled with turnovers (40 giveaways in last two games) and shot generation. Offensively, Travis Konecny leads in scoring (0g, 3a) despite missing two games, while Matvei Michkov (2g, 0a) is the only player with multiple goals. Defensively, they are hoping to get healthy defensemen back soon, with Cam York and Rasmus Ristolainen out. Recent roster moves include sending Carl Grundstrom to the AHL and recalling Jack Studnicka, with Michael Bunting poised to play his third game.
